16:111.text: On the Day when every soul will come disputing
for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged

16:112.text: And Allāh presents an example: a city

which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allāh. So Allāh made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.

16:113.text: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

16:114.text: Then eat of what Allāh has provided for you
lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allāh, if it is

16:115.text: He has only forbidden to you dead animals,
blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allāh. But whoever is forced
- then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

16:116.text: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allāh. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed.

16:117.text: a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.

16:118.text: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before.
And We did not wrong them
